items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You ever got a Vizedoffer's outfit, wasn't it? [INTERVIEWEE] Vizedoffer? Yeah.

ctx.x: You ever got a Vizedoffer's outfit, wasn't it?

Vizedoffer? Yeah. Well, Brown played out there too, but it looked like the band, when they had Raymond and Gus Miller and Lambert and those, they didn't care for those hard jobs. They were all trying to suck along on the easy work.
